VOCABULARIO;
L. littera... V. verbo.

L. A. V. amàr: lee, eria.
L. E. V. eſtera: lee, hipeta- de palma- taco- de carrizo- baca- de tule tobare.
L. F. V. fiar: lee, nahuiquiliatua.
L. G. V. grande: lee, bueruboca;

Ibid. pecar: caturiſiane.
L. Q. V. quebrantar la ley: lee, aneſaque cahipure[?]
L. V. V. un par: lee, huihalai.
lineBreakPolicy: Printed line structure is represented one correction per line rather than reproducing exact horizontal alignment. Long s is represented as ſ where visually legible. Square-bracket question marks mark unresolved letter sequences and are linked to uncertainties.

uncertainties.note: Corrected form in the F. 11 / n. 43 / l. 8 row is not fully legible in the available facsimile render; the medial sequence is preserved only provisionally.
Ending of the genitive form in the F. 37 / n. 225 / l. 11 row remains visually uncertain.
Final characters of the Q vocabulary correction are visually damaged/blurred; no completion is asserted.

materialNotes.note: The page contains two distinct historical correction blocks: general errata for the Arte and a separate VOCABULARIO correction list.
Several letterforms in the correction column are faint or blurred; unresolved sequences are retained explicitly rather than silently normalized.

provenance.method: Full printed-text transcription from high-resolution facsimile render with explicit unresolved tokens; provider OCR used only as a secondary comparison; no independent human verification
